Flying into Haneda after 10 p.m.? Here are the five checks we run before booking that first night. Step 5 often shows the airport hotel costs the same as town 👇

💴 The price gap surprised us. Take a guess, then look 👉 https://japanbystation.com/haneda-late-arrival-first-night

Save this before your flight 📌

1️⃣ CHECK THE LAST TRAIN

🚆 From Terminal 3 on a weekday: Asakusa 23:37, Shinjuku, Shibuya and Shinagawa 23:51, Hamamatsucho, Tokyo Station and Ueno 00:10 on the Tokyo Monorail.

⏱️ Add immigration and bags. For a 23:00 landing we assume arrivals at about 23:45 at best.

2️⃣ CHECK THE FRONT DESK

🛎️ Arriving at 1 a.m.? Make sure the listing says 24-hour front desk, or tell the hotel you'll be late.

3️⃣ KNOW THE NIGHT BUS

🚌 Airport Limousine late-night buses leave Terminal 3 at 0:20, 1:00, 1:40 and 2:20.

📍 They go to Shinjuku Station West Exit, Busta Shinjuku, Higashi-shinjuku and Ikebukuro, for ¥2,800 each.

4️⃣ PRICE THE TAXI FOR YOUR GROUP

🚕 Haneda fixed fares add 20% from 22:00 to 5:00.

💴 About ¥9,800 to Shinjuku, ¥9,200 to Shibuya, ¥9,900 to Ueno or Asakusa, plus about ¥1,000 in tolls.

👥 Worth it for two to four people. Less so alone.

5️⃣ COMPARE THE AIRPORT HOTEL

🏨 On Wed 16 Dec 2026, Villa Fontaine Grand Haneda Airport, connected to Terminal 3, was about ¥18,700 for two. Central business hotels were about the same.

✅ OUR RULE OF THUMB

Landing after about 22:30 with checked bags? Sleep at the airport and ride in from 5:26 the next morning.
